Apple___Apple_scab.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves and use sulfur-based organic fungicide where suitable.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Use a registered apple scab fungicide only according to label instructions.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Improve airflow, prune crowded branches, and clear fallen leaves.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.organic_treatment: Remove heavily infected leaves when practical and improve field airflow.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.chemical_treatment: Use a registered fungicide if rust pressure is high and crop stage justifies treatment.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Use resistant varieties and avoid overhead irrigation where possible.

Grape___Black_rot.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves and mummified fruit; apply approved organic fungicide early.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Use registered grape fungicides as part of a spray schedule.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Prune vines for airflow and remove infected plant debris.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves and avoid overhead watering.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Copper-based sprays may help reduce spread when applied correctly.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seed, rotate crops, and avoid working plants while wet.

Potato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Remove infected lower leaves and improve plant spacing.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Use a registered fungicide if infection is spreading.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops, avoid plant stress, and remove infected debris after harvest.

Potato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Remove infected plants quickly and avoid wet leaf conditions.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Use registered late blight fungicide immediately when disease risk is high.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Use certified seed potatoes, monitor in cool wet weather, and destroy volunteer plants.

Tomato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves or plants and avoid overhead watering.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Use registered fungicide as early as possible during high-risk weather.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Improve airflow, avoid wet foliage, and remove infected crop debris.

Tomato___healthy.prevention: Continue regular monitoring, balanced watering, and good plant spacing.
